text:
claire (Finance): Morning — cost dashboard flagged a weird cross-region bump. Bulk of extra Dedicated GPU spend moved to sa-east1 and is landing as 'internal-fallback' in the cost UI. Dashboard link: https://billing.internal/redwood/costs?range=24h&filter=sa-east1

cloud-bot: :warning: RegionFailoverAlert: autoscale fallback to region sa-east1 detected. Delta +27% vs baseline. Notifying #finance #eng-platform #finops

samir (FinOps): I pulled the billing export. Theres a ~USD 15.6k delta in the last 6 hours attributed to project acme-prod but billed to internal-fallback in sa-east1. Looks like our cross-region fallback rule also changes the "billing_bucket" routing to internal fallback when capacity is constrained.

molly (Platform Eng): Confirmed: yesterday we enabled multi-region autoscale with a priority list: us-west2 -> europe-west1 -> sa-east1 (as last resort). The fallback path used a different routing policy which set project=internal-fallback for quick provisioning. That was intended for dev sandboxes only; bug caused it to apply to production pools. Rolling a rollback now.

claire (Finance): Ouch — sa-east1 GPU spot/reserved rates are ~2.3x higher than us-west2. We need to reassign those hours back to acme-prod so Sales can decide whether to bill the customer for overage or absorb. Also vendor invoice shows different hours for sa-east1 than our export (possible double-counting?) — flagging for FinOps.

samir (FinOps): Backfill plan: 1) enumerate affected VM/instance IDs for the window 2) map them to acme-prod 3) re-run allocation job that reassigns cost by instance_id and reservation mapping. Quick query I'll run to list instances:  
```
SELECT resource.labels.instance_id, resource.zone, project.id, usage_start_time, cost
FROM `billing_export.gcp_resource_usage`
WHERE resource.zone LIKE '%sa-east1%' AND invoice.window_start >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 12 HOUR)
AND project.id IN ('internal-fallback','acme-prod')
```
Then I'll produce an instance list and proposed cost delta.

diego (Sales Ops): ACME contract RC-442 has a soft overage clause: they pay for >1000 GPU-hours/month or we absorb first 200 hours. We'll need exact hours and timestamps to apply the clause and notify the customer. I'll prep the customer notice template once Finance provides numbers.

molly (Platform Eng): Rolling back the fallback routing rule to stop assigning 'internal-fallback' on prod at 02:18 UTC. Also adding a guard so fallback keeps original project labels and only uses internal bucket for jobs with explicit tag 'sandbox-fallback'. PR: https://git.internal/r/policies/pull/912

ops-bot: Deploy succeeded: autoscale-controller v2.4.7 rolled at 02:21 UTC.

samir (FinOps): One weirdness: vendor invoice line items for sa-east1 show GPU-hours that are ~5% higher than our internal agg for the same window. Could be preemptions/restarts charged differently or an export ingestion duplication. I'll open a vendor-case and also run a dedupe check on our ingestion pipeline.

claire (Finance): Please cc finance on the vendor case. If vendor shows duplicate billing we fight it; if not, Sales will need to decide billing the customer for the regional premium. Finance prefers to avoid passing surprise high-costs to the customer without notice.

samir (FinOps): Created vendor ticket VND-2087 (cloud vendor billing mismatch). Also started backfill job job-backfill-2934 to remap costs once we confirm instance->project mapping. I'll post the exact instance list and USD delta in ~30m.

diego (Sales Ops): I'll hold any invoice changes until we have the reconciled numbers and vendor response. Will prep a customer note that explains the situation and options: (1) absorb, (2) bill overage with 7-day notice, (3) credit for regional premium.

molly (Platform Eng): Added short-term alert 'cross-region-fallback-production' that pages oncall and notifies #finance if a production pool falls back to a region not whitelisted for that project. Also landed the PR to preserve project labels on fallback.

cloud-bot: Monitor created: cross-region-fallback-production -> pages oncall + posts to #finance

samir (FinOps): Backfill job finished. Delta: reallocated USD 15,632 from internal-fallback(sa-east1) -> acme-prod for window 2026-03-21T22:00:00Z to 2026-03-22T04:00:00Z. I attached instance list and backfill job id: backfill-2934. Vendor case VND-2087 open; vendor acknowledges and investigating the 5% discrepancy.

claire (Finance): Thanks. Finance will hold invoice changes until vendor case closes and Sales confirms approach. Please retain audit trail for the reallocation. Leaving thread open until vendor closes and customer is notified. :white_check_mark:
